checks.note: Ciphertext transplant assertion failed against callable storage implementation before owner binding was encrypted and verified. Three other tests passed; host panic runtime then SIGABRT, so no completed failure summary is claimed. No claim that all three initial named tests were obtained red before implementation.

behavior: Existing authorize_plugin_mcp stores the full public-client grant through encrypted SecretStore, outside the original plugin package; provenance, tenant/session/server configuration bind the encrypted payload.

Issuer/client/resource/token endpoint remain in the encrypted grant; refresh rechecks source and discovered identity before sending refresh_token. Missing/invalid expiry and unsafe token values fail explicitly.

Async per-owner lock deduplicates in-process refresh; OS file lock rejects concurrent cross-process mutation. Refresh deletes expired state before provider I/O, so failure or cancellation cannot reuse it.
logout_plugin_mcp serializes against refresh, deletes the grant and cancels active connection entries; token changes participate in connection fingerprints and rebuild transport headers.

Five deterministic tests cover logout, explicit failure, independent owners, concurrent refreshed results, encryption and ciphertext-transplant rejection. Tests use real temporary files and real source parsing.

Real Sondahub public DCR + S256 code exchange uses documented auto=1 consent; forcing stored expiry to zero exercises production discovery/refresh, encrypted storage and the actual rmcp HTTP transport. The real MCP tool catalog is nonempty; after logout the same session cannot list tools. Original manifest bytes are identical.

public_acceptance.authorization: User authorized selecting a public test service; provider explicitly offers public playground testing and auto consent. No private account credentials used.
public_acceptance.limits: No claim of remote RFC7009 invalidation or desktop rendering. Provider documents stateless revocation; frozen Codex logout deletes local grants. This task verifies local credential/connection revocation against the real public service.

baseline_review.finding: Logout acquires the refresh credential lock, invalidates version and deletes local keyring/file credentials; it does not require provider-side revocation.
